source.dataset: DSText V2 official training media and annotations
source.selection_rule: the only Street_View_Indoor entry exposed by the already-admitted archive metadata

task: Predict whether a naturally occurring future view improves target-text semantic readability without using OCR outcome in view classification.

provider.target_region: evaluator-authoritative DSText quadrilateral for this mechanics canary only
provider.recognizer: existing PP-OCRv6 small recognition model; detection disabled
provider.rectification: perspective crop at native quadrilateral resolution
provider.semantic_score: frozen L10 lexical similarity between official transcription and recognized text

eligibility.track_transcription: not ### and at least three normalized alphanumeric characters
eligibility.quadrilateral: four finite points producing a non-empty in-frame perspective crop
eligibility.sampling: all eligible annotated track frames; no track, frame, or outcome subset selection

transition.pareto_aligned: future is no worse on all three quality coordinates and strictly better on at least one
transition.pareto_opposed: future is no better on all three quality coordinates and strictly worse on at least one
transition.mixed: excluded from the primary aligned-vs-opposed comparison

schema_adaptation_note: Eligibility fields were added after reading only the XML element and attribute schema and before any OCR outcome was produced; no gate or cohort selection changed.
claim_ceiling: Fresh public natural-video observability mechanics only. GT quadrilaterals are privileged proposals and recorded motion is passive, not controller-executed. No detector, exact-instance selection, live active-view causality, arrival, product, user-benefit, or safety claim.
